properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 is used for hashing in tools/agent-validation/browser/mock-cdp-server.js for test purposes. This is a weak cryptographic primitive that should be replaced with SHA-256 or better.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is a timing-side-channel vulnerability in the passless system where cryptographic hashes are compared using regular equality operators instead of constant-time comparison functions. This affects multiple files in the agent and pin storage modules.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 CTR mode is used in TPM storage modules (cmd/passless/src/pin_storage/tpm.rs, cmd/passless/src/storage/tpm/mod.rs) for encryption. While AES-128 is quantum-safe, the use of CTR mode without proper authentication is a weakness.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA encryption is used in the passless browser agent for key generation (2048-bit) and loading from PEM files. This is a quantum-vulnerable primitive that is subject to Shor's algorithm attack and needs to be replaced with ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Self-signed certificate is generated in tools/agent-uhid-feasibility/controlled-rp/gen_cert.sh. This creates a certificate without chain of trust, making it vulnerable to trust issues in testing scenarios.

properties.name: pqs:context
